## Answer quality (`python -m src.evals.answers`)

Configured generation model `gemini-3.5-flash-lite` with quota fallbacks; the answers were actually produced by `gemini-3.5-flash-lite` ×52. Judge `gemini-3.5-flash-lite` (JSON, temperature 0). 52 questions: 36 answerable (kind-stratified sample) and 16 unanswerable. Wilson 95% intervals.

| Answerable questions | |
|---|---|
| **answered, with every claim supported by the documents** | **81% (65%–90%)** |
| faithful when it answered (abstentions excluded) | 91% (76%–97%) |
| faithful, counting "the documents do not cover this" as faithful | 92% (78%–97%) |
| says the documents do not cover it (abstains) | 11% (4%–25%) |
| the pipeline's top-3 contained a labelled section | 89% (75%–96%) |
| citations correct | 100% (90%–100%) |
| cites at least one document | 97% (86%–100%) |
| cites a document number that was not provided | 0% (0%–10%) |

| Unanswerable questions | |
|---|---|
| correctly says the documents do not cover it | 15/16 (72%–99%) |
| unsupported content when it answered anyway | 1/1 (21%–100%) |

Answers cut off by the token limit: 0. The judge is the same model family that generated the answers, which can favour its own output, and it is unverified until `evals/judge_agreement_sheet.csv` is labelled by a person (`python -m src.evals.answers --agreement`).

## Red team (`python -m src.evals.redteam`)

Each prompt runs through two configurations. *Without the safety layers*: same retriever, knowledge base and model with the Phase 2 safety layers removed: no input guard, Phase 1 system prompt and task wording, SHAP-prefixed retrieval query, the 12 original output patterns. *With*: the production pipeline (run_pipeline, default single-call mode). Replies written by the LLM are judged by `gemini-3.5-flash-lite` against a written rule per category. Wilson 95% intervals; denominators under 20 are shown as counts. The development set is a regression suite: the guardrails were written against it, so only the held-out set estimates behaviour on new phrasings, and both sets are small.
